subject: ela
intro: Use context to pick the meaning.

items.prompt:
Read.

A habitat is the place where an animal lives.

'Habitat' means:
A) a kind of food
B) the place where an animal lives
C) a baby animal
items.answer: B) the place where an animal lives

steps: Defined in text. Key is B.
solution.answer: B) the place where an animal lives
